fields.label: Experiment
fields.description: V2 section 44.1: 'The plan should be saved before inferential results are generated.'

fields.label: Estimand
fields.description: What quantity this plan actually estimates (e.g. 'mean difference in sequence entropy between broad_autonomy and specialist_handoff').

fields.label: Outcome Metric
fields.description: An EORL Metric.metric_name this plan compares (e.g. 'sequence_entropy', 'actor_continuity', 'success_rate') -- computed per RUN via eorl_lab.api.metrics.compute_run_metrics, never per episode for a between-condition comparison (see analysis_unit below).

fields.label: Factor(s)
fields.description: Free-text description of which factor(s) define the groups being compared (e.g. 'coordination_structure'). Group membership itself is supplied by the caller of eorl_lab.api.analysis.compare_groups as two lists of run names, not derived automatically from this field.

fields.label: Analysis Unit
fields.description: V2 section 44.2's independence guardrail: 'Episodes inside one run are NOT independent replications.' eorl_lab.api.analysis.compare_groups REFUSES to run a between-condition comparison when this is 'episode' -- there is no mixed-effects/GEE path built yet (P1), so there is no honest hierarchical alternative to fall back to; it blocks outright rather than silently treating episodes as independent.

fields.label: Cluster Unit
fields.description: Descriptive only in this phase (e.g. 'run') -- displayed alongside N independent runs / N episodes per V2 section 44.2's UI requirement; not yet fed into a clustered/mixed-effects model.

fields.label: Paired By
fields.description: Set to 'branch_point' to declare that the two compared groups are matched, equal-length, position-corresponding sibling counterfactual branches (V2 section 44.3) -- eorl_lab.api.analysis.compare_groups then VERIFIES every pair actually shares a common parent_run/branch_point_episode before running paired tests, and throws rather than silently falling back to an independent-groups test if that verification fails. Leave blank for an ordinary independent-groups comparison.

fields.label: Time Window
fields.description: Descriptive only in this phase -- e.g. 'episodes 1-10' or 'pre-shock only'. Not yet enforced by compare_groups; filter the run/episode sets passed in yourself.

fields.label: Model Family
fields.description: Which test family eorl_lab.api.analysis.compare_groups actually runs. V2 section 44.4: the system may RECOMMEND a test but must never silently select one -- compare_groups always computes and returns BOTH the parametric and permutation result for the chosen pairing mode (independent or paired), regardless of this field; this field only labels which one the researcher intends to report as primary. EXCEPTION: when analysis_unit='episode' (SOTA Milestone 6), this field is REQUIRED to be 'mixed_effects' -- that is the one case compare_groups actually reads and enforces this field, since it is the only hierarchical model honestly justifying episode-level analysis at all.

fields.label: Formula
fields.description: Reserved for the model-based test families (linear model / GLM / mixed model) named in V2 section 44.4 -- not implemented yet (P1); this field is not read by compare_groups today.

fields.label: Covariates
fields.description: Reserved, same P1 scope as Formula above.

fields.label: Multiple Testing Family
fields.description: Reserved (V2 section 46) -- no multiple-testing correction is applied yet; not implemented.

fields.label: Equivalence Bounds
fields.description: Reserved (V2 section 45.1, TOST equivalence testing) -- not implemented yet; not read by compare_groups.

fields.label: Bootstrap Iterations
fields.description: Reserved -- no bootstrap CI is implemented in this phase; the Welch CI uses the standard closed-form Welch-Satterthwaite interval instead.

fields.label: Exclusion Rule
fields.description: Descriptive only in this phase -- not enforced automatically; exclude runs from the lists you pass to compare_groups yourself.
